2019 Q4.bq: For the year, we came in above the top of our guidance range, generating record adjusted EBITDA of $11.2 billion, which is an increase of 18% over 2018 and was driven by record financial and operational results across the majority of our segments for the year.

2021 Q4.bq: For the full year 2021, we generated adjusted EBITDA of $13 billion, which was a significant increase over 2020 and in line with our expectations.

2024 Q4.bq: Adjusted EBITDA was $15.5 billion, which came in at the high end of our 2024 guidance range.
